private_lines.Yu-ting: You run a phone accessories stall at the market on weekends and spend weekdays restocking cases, chargers and cables, sorting orders and doing the books at your flat in Taipei. You live with your husband and your teenage son, and your days are busy with stock, meals and errands.
private_lines.Tsung-han: You run a wholesale dried goods business supplying market stalls and shops across Taipei, which means early mornings at the warehouse, deliveries and invoices through the day. You live alone in an apartment near the market, and your days are structured around supply runs and the weekend stall.
private_lines.Ya-hui: You run a stall at the market on weekends and in the evenings, and you attend night school on weekdays to finish a diploma. You live with your parents in a small flat in Taipei, and your days are split between class, coursework and helping at the stall.
